title: 📊 Daily Report: Mon Nov 2, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $18,288.51. This week it's down $311.30 from Monday's base, with the strategies down $24.88 and CORE QQQ down $286.42, so the week starts in a deficit. Since the merge, the book is down 8.65% ($1,732.23), while Indy (the SPY benchmark) is down 3.28% ($657.08). That puts the book $1,075.15 behind SPY.

Trek and Rota traded today. Trek stopped out of USO for a $23.89 loss and bought one share of ACN on a 15-day breakout. Rota stopped out of P for a $26.31 loss. CORE QQQ trimmed back to 81% of the book (about $14,815) and booked a $127.24 loss on that trim. Its trend signal is still on, since QQQ's prior close of 690.49 sits above its 200-day average of 678.37. Idle cash earned $0.71 in interest.

Research's analyst note for today: It was a mixed close, with the Dow up 0.6%, the S&P 500 down 0.3%, and the Nasdaq down 0.7%. A morning tech bounce faded again, so the AI selloff isn't over. Oil drove the day, falling about 7% on hopes for US-Iran peace talks, and Research added the whole energy group to the avoid list at midday. Non-tech companies that beat and raised kept rallying, led by IDEXX at +22%. Oracle and Lumentum stay on the avoid list. After the bell, Palantir beat and raised, and Apple reports tonight. Coming up are the midterm elections and JOLTS tomorrow, AMD and Amgen after Tuesday's close, ISM Services on Wednesday, and payrolls on Friday.

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/
